story_type: tiltrotor water hoist training in rotor wash spray
hook: This Osprey's rotor wash turned the water into a storm.
narration: The rotor wash from this Osprey turned the water into a storm.
A crewman waited in the water below it, near Hurlburt Field, Florida.
The CV-22 takes off like a helicopter, then tilts its rotors forward to fly like a plane.
In a hover, those two big rotors drive air straight down, hard enough to whip the surface into a wall of spray.
The airmen rose out of the spray on the cable, clipped on together.
Above them, the hoist kept winding them up toward the open door.
outcome: The 8th Special Operations Squadron crew hoisted both men back up into the Osprey.
title: Osprey rotor wash turns water into a storm
description:
On July 19, 2016, aircrew from the 8th Special Operations Squadron flew a CV-22B Osprey for water hoist training at Hurlburt Field, Florida.

Footage: U.S. Air Force video by Senior Airman James Merriman, 1st Special Operations Wing, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/487717
